race.comment: CAFE AU LAIT (16) drops back to a winning trip off 39 days between runs and gets a key switch in Thompson. Was okay last time at Doomben in this grade without threatening but should be at her top now. IMPERVIOUS (11) was a sharp improver second-up at Eagle Farm when chasing gamely into the placings. Stretches to a pet trip third-up and with a clever ride from the wide alley she can break a long run of outs. TASMAN BAY (15) resumes from a short break and has built quite the profile. Is another likely leader who will give her backers another great look. MIDNIGHT SPIRIT (6) kicked off the campaign in good order but has lost his way a touch of late. Worth one more look with Maloney going back on.
